id: The Racket Lounge-Bedlam And Squalor, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: The Racket Lounge
long_description:
Grab a spot on our couch and enjoy the noise at The Racket Lounge - a chill classical music series showcasing up-and-coming Pōneke musicians.

If you’ve never been to a classical concert before, or if you have and now you want to see talented emerging musicians experimenting and playing what they want to play, then The Racket Lounge is for you. Over the past two seasons we’ve seen classical covers, jazz ensembles, video game soundtracks, original compositions, loop pedals, poetry and much more. Our 2026 season is shaping up to be just as epic, plus with your tickets starting at just $5 you can afford to take a chance on something new.

Each concert will feature a different line up of musicians and genres, to be announced a week before each session. If you’re a musician looking to perform at The Racket Lounge, then head to the New Zealand String Quartet’s website to see how to apply.



The Racket Lounge is created and presented by the New Zealand String Quartet Trust - Te Rōpū Tūrū o Aotearoa, New Zealand’s longest-running professional string quartet. With support from Wellington City Council.

Tickets are choose your price starting from just $5.

Please note that Bedlam & Squalor is a licensed venue, so under 18s must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. Everyone must bring ID.

id: Evie Bamford 'Now Rising, Now Falling' Release Tour-San Fran, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Evie Bamford 'Now Rising, Now Falling' Release Tour
long_description:
Eyegum Free Wednesdays | Evie Bamford & Emily Alice

Following a breakthrough year, Auckland-based songwriter, producer and multi-instrumentalist Evie Bamford releases her debut EP Now Rising, Now Falling on 1 September, and will be taking it on the road with her band to celebrate.

Across six tracks, the EP explores anxiety, self-worth, relationships and resilience, documenting a period of growing up through warm, intricately arranged indie rock.

id: Wellington Calling Open Mic-The Undercurrent, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Wellington Calling Open Mic
long_description:
The Undercurrent presents the Wellington Calling Open Mic!

The Undercurrent is hosting the Wellington Calling Open Mic and we're looking for diverse acts to contribute! Each performer gets the chance to have a six-minute set with a microphone, guitar and piano provided. This is an originals only event. We want to encourage new creative voices to be heard. “We want to provide a positive and encouraging environment for established and fledgling acts to shine in. It's a pretty inspiring place to perform,” says host Steven Hood.

Each performer will need to sign up in person before 7:30pm and registrations of interest need to be emailed to openwandw@gmail.com before September 10.

The feature act is Elyssa Vulpes with Catherine Ireland. Italian-born, Wellington-based, twenty-five years on stage Elyssa Vulpes brings violinist Catherine Ireland to the Undercurrent with atmospheric indie-folk ballads in English and Italian, raw and Celtic-tinged, real-life stories that walk into the melancholic and find their way back to light.

Thursday September 10
Doors 7pm
Music 7:30pm
Koha entry

Snacks, a range of refreshing drinks, tea & coffee, and of course...books available for purchase!

We’ll see you there ☆

long_description:
Rory Johns and The Mystic is a jazz-influenced ensemble led by pianist Rory Johns.

Drawing on influences such as Nala Sinephro, Ancient Infinity Orchestra, and Bill Laurance, the group blends contemporary jazz, ambient textures, and improvisation to create immersive, atmospheric music that moves fluidly between composed passages and spontaneous exploration.

Music from 8pm, FREE ENTRY - Koha for the band encouraged!

Free entry!

id: Tessa De Lyon - E.p Release With Stan Antonio-Vogelmorn Upstairs, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Tessa De Lyon - E.p Release With Stan Antonio
long_description:
Come and celebrate Tessa de Lyon’s latest release, Heart Melt, a six track E.P that has already broken the charts for melting hearts.
Released just in time for the spring thaw, Heart Melt is chock-a-block full of warm and sweet tunes, some about misery, most about joy, and all celebrating a love for the bewildering journey of it all. Recorded in a lo-fi fashion out of her own home, Tessa de Lyon is taking the music to the stage for a live rendition.

You’ll be in for an evening of eclectic instrumentation; harmonicas, xylophones, banjos… all sorts! Tessa de Lyon will be accompanied by talented musicians such as Olivia Campion (Mystery Waitress, Yumi Zouma), Alex Howie (Stan Antonio) and Brooke Singer (French For Rabbits).

Tessa de Lyon received glowing reviews for her debut album, ‘Tessa’s Album’, released in late 2024. Praised for her “mellifluous voice” and songs that are “quietly impactful” “full of hope” and “comforting melodies”, she has since performed on RNZ live with Jesse Mulligan, and opened for some of Aotearoa’s finest musical acts including Womb, Fazed On A Pony, Louis TM, Violet Hirst and more.

Phoebe and Alex of Stan Antonio grew up attending folk festivals and have played around Wellington as part of various folk groups. They dabble in the realms of Americana, folk, and bluegrass, and have recently been writing music together. Their influences include classic artists such as Gillian Welch and Dave Rawlings, more contemporary artists such as Adrianne Lenker. They aspire to use the banjo as a force for good in this world, alongside close harmonies and acoustic guitar.

name: Dani
long_description:
The Undercurrent presents DANI!

DANI is a Wellington-based artist whose music moves through the haze of smoky chamber pop: intimate and cinematic, it makes you feel like a secret being told just to you. 

DANI is a daydreamer who takes action. She soaks up the experience of life in lessons and finds the way to craft it into lyrics that would live as a reminder to be true to ourselves.

Join Dani and her chamber pop team:

Andrew Kerr - harmonica and bodhran
Charley Davenport - cello and bass
Giacomo Caleffi - guitar and bass
Elliot Vaughan - viola
Emmie Ellis - backing vocals

Friday Sept 11
Doors 7pm
Music 7:30pm
$20 ($15 unwaged door sales)

Tickets available online and at the door!

Snacks, a range of refreshing drinks, tea & coffee, and of course...books available for purchase!

We’ll see you there ☆
